% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
% Reversible with lp2graph.codec.from_canonical_latex (schema 0.1.0).
%@ meta id=rail_reschedule family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Rolling‑horizon railway timetable and rolling‑stock reassignment
%@ desc :: MILP model integrating dynamic timetable rescheduling, train cancellations, short‑turning, stop‑skipping and insertion of extra services under uncertain disruption durations.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of trips.
%@ index R ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of rolling‑stock units.
%@ index S ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of stations (potential stop‑skipping points).
%@ param d0 shape=T kind=vector domain=time :: Original scheduled departure time of each trip.
%@ param disc shape=T kind=vector domain=time :: Expected disruption duration affecting each trip.
%@ param cost_delay shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Cost per unit of delay.
%@ param cost_cancel shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Penalty cost for cancelling a trip.
%@ param cost_shortturn shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Cost for short‑turning a trip.
%@ param cost_skip shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Cost per skipped stop.
%@ param cost_extra shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Cost per additional train service.
%@ param M_big shape=- kind=scalar domain=bigM :: Big‑M constant.
%@ param max_skip shape=- kind=scalar domain=integer :: Maximum number of stops that may be skipped per trip.
%@ var delay shape=T domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Additional delay for each trip.
%@ var cancel shape=T domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Cancellation decision.
%@ var shortturn shape=T domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Short‑turn decision.
%@ var skip shape=T,S domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Stop‑skipping decision.
%@ var assign shape=R,T domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Assignment of rolling‑stock unit to trip.
%@ var extra shape=R domain=integer role=auxiliary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Additional train services for each rolling‑stock type.
%@ obj sense=min name=total_cost combination=sum :: Minimize weighted sum of delay, cancellations, short‑turns, skipped stops and extra services.
%@ con delay_if_not_cancel kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Enforce delay only if trip is not cancelled.
%@ con assignment kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Ensure each non‑cancelled trip is assigned to exactly one rolling‑stock unit.
%@ con capacity kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Rolling‑stock capacity with extra services.
%@ con delay_min_due_to_disruption kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Minimum delay caused by disruption unless cancelled.
%@ con skip_limit kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Limit number of skipped stops per trip.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \mathit{cost\_delay} \cdot \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} delay_{t}
            + \mathit{cost\_cancel} \cdot \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} cancel_{t}
            + \mathit{cost\_shortturn} \cdot \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} shortturn_{t}
            + \mathit{cost\_skip} \cdot \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}, s \in \mathcal{S}} skip_{t,s}
            + \mathit{cost\_extra} \cdot \sum_{r \in \mathcal{R}} extra_{r}
            \tag{total\_cost} \\
  & delay_{t} + \mathit{M\_big} \cdot cancel_{t} \le \mathit{M\_big}
    \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{delay\_if\_not\_cancel} \\
  & \sum_{r \in \mathcal{R}} assign_{r,t} + cancel_{t} = 1
    \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{assignment} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} assign_{r,t} \le 1 + extra_{r}
    \qquad \forall r \in \mathcal{R} \tag{capacity} \\
  & \mathit{disc}_{t} - delay_{t} - \mathit{M\_big} \cdot cancel_{t} \le 0
    \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{delay\_min\_due\_to\_disruption} \\
  & \sum_{s \in \mathcal{S}} skip_{t,s} + \mathit{max\_skip} \cdot cancel_{t} \le \mathit{max\_skip}
    \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{skip\_limit}
\end{align}

% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
% Rolling‑horizon railway operations MILP (dynamic timetable & rolling‑stock reassignment)
%@ meta id=rolling_horizon_rail family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Rolling‑horizon MILP for railway timetable rescheduling and rolling‑stock reassignment
%@ desc :: Mixed‑integer linear model that minimizes total delay, cancellation penalties, short‑turn and stop‑skipping costs, and costs of inserting additional services while respecting train‑trip compatibility and fleet capacity.
%@ index T ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of trains.
%@ index R ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Set of trips (services) in the planning horizon.
%@ param D shape=R kind=vector domain=time_duration :: Nominal duration of each trip.
%@ param Sched shape=R kind=vector domain=time_duration :: Scheduled departure time of each trip.
%@ param delta_short shape=R kind=vector domain=time_duration :: Time reduction when a short‑turn is applied.
%@ param delta_skip shape=R kind=vector domain=time_duration :: Time reduction when stop‑skipping is applied.
%@ param C_delay shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Cost per unit of delay.
%@ param C_cancel shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Penalty cost for cancelling a trip.
%@ param C_short shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Cost for applying a short‑turn.
%@ param C_skip shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Cost for applying stop‑skipping.
%@ param C_add shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Cost for inserting an additional service.
%@ param M shape=- kind=scalar domain=bigM :: Large constant for big‑M formulations.
%@ param compat shape=T,R kind=matrix domain=bool :: Compatibility indicator (1 if train t can serve trip r).
%@ var x shape=R domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Trip r is operated (1) or cancelled (0).
%@ var y shape=T,R domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Train t assigned to trip r.
%@ var s shape=R domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Short‑turn applied to trip r.
%@ var k shape=R domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Stop‑skipping applied to trip r.
%@ var a shape=R domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Additional service inserted for trip r.
%@ var dep shape=R domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Departure time of trip r.
%@ var delay shape=R domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Delay of trip r beyond its schedule.
%@ obj sense=min name=total_cost combination=sum :: Minimize total operational cost.
%@ con assign kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Assignment of trains or additional service to each trip.
%@ con train_cap kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Each train serves at most one trip in the horizon.
%@ con dep_lb kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Departure time respects schedule unless cancelled.
%@ con delay_def kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Delay definition.
%@ con short_act kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Short‑turn activation only if trip is operated.
%@ con skip_act kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Stop‑skipping activation only if trip is operated.
%@ con add_act kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Additional service only if original trip is cancelled.
%@ con compat kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Train‑trip compatibility.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{r \in \mathcal{R}} \mathit{C\_delay} \cdot delay_{r}
            + \sum_{r \in \mathcal{R}} \mathit{C\_cancel} \cdot (1 - x_{r})
            + \sum_{r \in \mathcal{R}} \mathit{C\_short} \cdot s_{r}
            + \sum_{r \in \mathcal{R}} \mathit{C\_skip} \cdot k_{r}
            + \sum_{r \in \mathcal{R}} \mathit{C\_add} \cdot a_{r}
            \tag{total\_cost} \\
  & \sum_{t \in \mathcal{T}} y_{t,r} + a_{r} = x_{r}
      \qquad \forall r \in \mathcal{R} \tag{assign} \\
  & \sum_{r \in \mathcal{R}} y_{t,r} \le 1
      \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T} \tag{train\_cap} \\
  & dep_{r} \ge Sched_{r} - \mathit{M} \cdot (1 - x_{r})
      \qquad \forall r \in \mathcal{R} \tag{dep\_lb} \\
  & delay_{r} \ge dep_{r} - Sched_{r}
      \qquad \forall r \in \mathcal{R} \tag{delay\_def} \\
  & s_{r} \le x_{r}
      \qquad \forall r \in \mathcal{R} \tag{short\_act} \\
  & k_{r} \le x_{r}
      \qquad \forall r \in \mathcal{R} \tag{skip\_act} \\
  & a_{r} \le 1 - x_{r}
      \qquad \forall r \in \mathcal{R} \tag{add\_act} \\
  & y_{t,r} \le compat_{t,r}
      \qquad \forall t \in \mathcal{T},\; \forall r \in \mathcal{R} \tag{compat} \\
\end{align}

% lp2graph canonical LaTeX
% Reversible with lp2graph.codec.from_canonical_latex (schema 0.1.0).
%@ meta id=rolling_horizon_railway family=milp schema=0.1.0
%@ name :: Rolling‑horizon railway rescheduling and stock reassignment
%@ desc :: MILP model integrating timetable adjustments, cancellations, short‑turning, stop‑skipping and insertion of additional services under uncertain disruption durations.
%@ index R ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Rolling‑stock units (trains).
%@ index I ordered=0 cyclic=0 :: Service trips (original and potential additional).
%@ param d shape=I kind=vector domain=time_duration :: Nominal duration of trip i.
%@ param a shape=I kind=vector domain=time :: Earliest feasible start time of trip i.
%@ param b shape=I kind=vector domain=time :: Latest feasible finish time of trip i.
%@ param p shape=I kind=vector domain=cost :: Penalty cost for cancelling original trip i.
%@ param c shape=I kind=vector domain=cost :: Operational cost coefficient for trip i.
%@ param st_red shape=I kind=vector domain=time :: Time reduction if short‑turning is applied to trip i.
%@ param ss_red shape=I kind=vector domain=time :: Time reduction if stop‑skipping is applied to trip i.
%@ param orig shape=I kind=vector domain=bool :: Indicator =1 if i is an original scheduled trip, 0 if i is a potential additional service.
%@ param bigM shape=- kind=scalar domain=bigM :: Big‑M constant.
%@ param alpha shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Weight for total delay.
%@ param beta shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Cost per short‑turn.
%@ param gamma shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Cost per stop‑skip.
%@ param delta shape=- kind=scalar domain=cost :: Cost per inserted additional service.
%@ var x shape=I,R domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Assignment of trip i to train r (if not cancelled).
%@ var y shape=I domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Cancellation indicator for original trips.
%@ var s shape=I domain=continuous role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Start time of trip i.
%@ var delay shape=I domain=non_negative role=primary drole=- lo=0 hi=- :: Delay of trip i relative to earliest start.
%@ var w shape=I domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Short‑turn indicator for trip i.
%@ var u shape=I domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Stop‑skip indicator for trip i.
%@ var z shape=I domain=binary role=primary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Activation indicator for additional service i.
%@ var o shape=I,I,R domain=binary role=auxiliary drole=- lo=- hi=- :: Ordering binary: 1 if i precedes j on train r.
%@ obj sense=min name=total_cost combination=sum :: Minimize weighted sum of delay, penalties, and operational costs.
%@ con assign_cancel kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Assignment vs cancellation / activation linking.
%@ con cancel_link kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Cancellation allowed only for original trips.
%@ con extra_link kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Additional service activation only for non‑original trips.
%@ con time_low kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Lower bound on start time with big‑M.
%@ con time_up kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Upper bound on start time with big‑M.
%@ con delay_def kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Definition of delay.
%@ con order_link1 kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Ordering variable ≤ assignment (i).
%@ con order_link2 kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Ordering variable ≤ assignment (j).
%@ con order_link3 kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Ordering variable ≥ sum of assignments − 1.
%@ con precede1 kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Precedence when i precedes j on same train.
%@ con precede2 kind=- domain=- indicator=- :: Precedence when j precedes i on same train.
\begin{align}
  \min\quad & \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I}} \big( \mathit{alpha} \cdot \mathit{delay}_{i} + \mathit{p}_{i} \cdot \mathit{y}_{i} + \mathit{beta} \cdot \mathit{w}_{i} + \mathit{gamma} \cdot \mathit{u}_{i} + \mathit{delta} \cdot \mathit{z}_{i} \big) + \sum_{i \in \mathcal{I},\, r \in \mathcal{R}} \mathit{c}_{i} \cdot \mathit{x}_{i,r} \tag{total\_cost} \\
  & \sum_{r \in \mathcal{R}} \mathit{x}_{i,r} + \mathit{y}_{i} = \mathit{orig}_{i} + \mathit{z}_{i} - \mathit{orig}_{i} \cdot \mathit{z}_{i} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I} \tag{assign\_cancel} \\
  & \mathit{y}_{i} \le \mathit{orig}_{i} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I} \tag{cancel\_link} \\
  & \mathit{z}_{i} \le 1 - \mathit{orig}_{i} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I} \tag{extra\_link} \\
  & \mathit{a}_{i} - \mathit{bigM} \cdot \mathit{y}_{i} \le \mathit{s}_{i} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I} \tag{time\_low} \\
  & \mathit{s}_{i} \le \mathit{b}_{i} + \mathit{bigM} \cdot \mathit{y}_{i} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I} \tag{time\_up} \\
  & \mathit{delay}_{i} \ge \mathit{s}_{i} - \mathit{a}_{i} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I} \tag{delay\_def} \\
  & \mathit{o}_{i,j,r} \le \mathit{x}_{i,r} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I},\, j \in \mathcal{I},\, r \in \mathcal{R} \tag{order\_link1} \\
  & \mathit{o}_{i,j,r} \le \mathit{x}_{j,r} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I},\, j \in \mathcal{I},\, r \in \mathcal{R} \tag{order\_link2} \\
  & \mathit{o}_{i,j,r} \ge \mathit{x}_{i,r} + \mathit{x}_{j,r} - 1 \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I},\, j \in \mathcal{I},\, r \in \mathcal{R} \tag{order\_link3} \\
  & \mathit{s}_{j} \ge \mathit{s}_{i} + \mathit{d}_{i} - \mathit{st\_red}_{i} \cdot \mathit{w}_{i} - \mathit{ss\_red}_{i} \cdot \mathit{u}_{i} - \mathit{bigM} + \mathit{bigM} \cdot \mathit{o}_{i,j,r} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I},\, j \in \mathcal{I},\, r \in \mathcal{R} \tag{precede1} \\
  & \mathit{s}_{i} \ge \mathit{s}_{j} + \mathit{d}_{j} - \mathit{st\_red}_{j} \cdot \mathit{w}_{j} - \mathit{ss\_red}_{j} \cdot \mathit{u}_{j} - \mathit{bigM} \cdot \mathit{o}_{i,j,r} \qquad \forall i \in \mathcal{I},\, j \in \mathcal{I},\, r \in \mathcal{R} \tag{precede2}
\end{align}
